criteria.criterion: A fold killed at ANY step boundary leaves a store that the next sweep entry converges to clean (no dirty tracked deletions, no stray snapshots, no lost events); checked by the crash-injection tests.
A fold that cannot journal refuses without mutating the store; checked by the refusal test.
Recovery never deletes folded-event bytes: incomplete rollback retains the snapshot, and landed/superseded journals are cleared without reverting ticket files; checked by the discrimination tests.
Transient git faults during recovery probes are not treated as 'snapshot absent'; checked by the fault-injection test.
